articles.headline: Vanderbilt PG Tyler Tanner withdraws from NBA draft
articles.description: Vanderbilt's Tyler Tanner, one of the elite point guards in the country, told ESPN on Wednesday that he has withdrawn from the NBA draft and will return for his junior season.

articles.headline: Milan Momcilovic withdraws from NBA draft, set for college return
articles.description: Former Iowa State forward Milan Momcilovic, the No. 1 player in the transfer portal, is withdrawing from the NBA draft and will play college basketball next season, his agents told ESPN.
